'''Jem Waulse''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who visited the town of [[Raider's Cove]] on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jem Waulse appears as a smuggler trainer in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
